skill.summary: 中国热点一网打尽，聚合抖音/微博/百度/头条/小红书/知乎/快手7大平台热榜数据，支持趋势对比、热度预警、内容选题。触发词：'今日热点'、'热搜'、'爆款选题'、'热点监控'、'热度趋势'、'全网热点'。内容创作者/运营者必备。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of china-hot-monitor.
- Aggregates trending topics from 7 major Chinese platforms: Douyin, Weibo, Baidu, Toutiao, Xiaohongshu, Zhihu, and Kuaishou.
- Supports trend comparisons, hot topic alerts, and content ideation tailored for creators and operators.
- Multiple trigger phrases activate the feature, including “今日热点”, “爆款选题”, and others.
- Provides multi-platform hot lists, topic analysis, trend comparisons, and creation templates.
